verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS identity platform and its SDKs and MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control. The community comments are about breaches and support-portal data handling, not telemetry, so they do not bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
